_comment: Mapping from Action Network JSON export fields to SimplifiedInitialImport CSV columns.

fields.note: Phone numbers do not appear to be returned by the Action Network API — the number field is absent from exported records even when a phone is present. May need to be sourced elsewhere.
postal_addresses[0].region is often empty. Fall back to custom_fields["State (AU)"] when it is.

fields.transform_detail: JSON uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (e.g. "AU"). CSV uses full names (e.g. "Australia"). Apply lookup or hardcode AU → Australia for this dataset.

fields.note: Notes are not exposed by the Action Network API. Must be exported manually from the Action Network admin UI, or set to a static value (e.g. "Exported from AN DD-MM-YYYY") as seen in the sample CSV.
